claims.content: To enter and validate claim transaction details including patient, treatment, and financial information into the system for reimbursement processing.

goal.raw_text: To enter and validate claim transaction details including patient, treatment, and financial information into the system for reimbursement processing.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The MSIU Field Office User must be authenticated and authorized to access the Claim Entry / Processing module.
The Service Provider must have completed the standardized patient treatment documentation form and summary claims form for reimbursement.
Master data records (including Drugs, Syndrome, Clinical Examination, Diagnosis, Lab Test, Patient Status, and Claim Status) must exist in the system to support claim validation and entry.
The MSIU Field Office User receives the completed standardized patient treatment documentation form and summary claims form from the Service Provider for reimbursement.

trigger.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User receives the completed standardized patient treatment documentation form and summary claims form from the Service Provider for reimbursement.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User selects the 'Claim Entry / Processing' module.

The system displays a form for entering claim transaction details, including fields such as Submitted Date, VSP Name, Voucher No, Visit Count, Patient Type, Patient Name, Age, Gender, Address, Contact No, Doctor Name, Doctors Note, HIV Details if any, Patient Status, Claim Amount, and Claim Status.
The user enters the master information and transaction details of the claim from the standardized patient treatment documentation form and summary claims form provided by the Service Provider.
The system performs data checks and plausibilisations on the entered claim data against existing master records (e.g., Drugs Master, Syndrome Master, Diagnosis Master, etc.).
If all data validations pass, the system saves the claim record to the database with status indicating it is ready for reimbursement processing.
The system confirms successful registration of the claim submission to the user.
If data checks and plausibilisations fail during step 3, the system flags the claim as conspicuous for investigation by the VMU.
If Contact No is missing during claim entry, the system allows continuation since it is not mandatory per design constraints.
If Treatment Form No corresponds to a form not yet entered in the system, the system permits entry but may flag for follow-up validation.
If mandatory information is incomplete during claim entry, the system rejects the claim submission and does not accept it for processing.
If data checks or plausibilisations fail during validation, the system flags the claim as conspicuous and routes it for investigation by the VMU instead of proceeding to reimbursement.
The claim transaction details, including patient, treatment, and financial information, are successfully entered into the computer database.
Data checks and plausibilisations have been performed on the entered claim data.
If the claim is clean (passes validation), it is marked for reimbursement via bank transfer.
If the claim is conspicuous (fails validation), it is flagged for investigation and clearance by the VMU.
The system has recorded all mandatory master-level information except Contact No, as per design constraints.
A unique Claim Number has been automatically generated by the system using Hospital Code as Suffix + 8 digit format.
